plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU, METU) to zero for capital preservation.
Trim SPY to 20% to meet the single name concentration mandate.
Increase QQQI to 25% to favor income and broad index exposure.
This plan prioritizes capital preservation and reduces overall portfolio risk.
conservative.read: This conservative plan aims for a target of ~1.5% per month, focusing on capital preservation. It significantly reduces risk by eliminating leveraged ETFs and lowering concentration. Expect lower volatility and drawdowns, but also more modest returns.

plan: Trim SOXL, SPAL, MUU, and METU to reduce overall leverage and address below-stop holdings.
Reduce SPY to 25% to meet the single name concentration mandate.
Buy AMD at 4% as a strong scanner setup to add quality tech exposure.
This plan balances risk and growth, maintaining a small leveraged ETF presence.
balanced.read: This balanced plan targets ~2.5% per month, focusing on risk-first growth. It reduces leverage and concentration while adding a high-quality scanner setup. Expect moderate volatility and drawdowns, with a blend of broad market and quality tech exposure.

plan: Add to SOXL, MUU, METU, and SPAL to lean into leveraged ETFs and press what is working.
Trim SPY to 25% to meet the single name concentration mandate.
Buy AMD at 6% as a strong scanner setup to add concentrated growth.
This plan stretches for growth, using leverage and concentration with strict stops.
aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets ~4% per month, aiming for stretch growth. It significantly increases exposure to leveraged ETFs and concentrates in high-scoring setups. Be aware of higher potential drawdowns and the daily decay/rebalancing of leveraged ETFs; strict stop discipline is critical.

plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU, METU) to zero to prioritize low drawdown.
Trim SPY to 20% to meet the single name concentration mandate.
Add to QQQI, increasing to 30% to rotate into income-focused ETFs.
This plan prioritizes steady monthly distributions and capital preservation.
income.read: This income plan targets ~1% per month, focusing on parking cash for yield. It eliminates high-beta and leveraged holdings, rotating into income-generating ETFs. While aiming for reliable income and low drawdown, distributions are variable, and NAV can still decline in market selloffs.
